**Eiffel Tower (Tour Eiffel)**  
- **Location:** Champ de Mars, 5 Avenue Anatole France, 75007 Paris, France  
- **Why it’s famous:** The iconic iron lattice tower was completed in 1889 for the Exposition Universelle and has become a global symbol of Paris and French engineering. It attracts millions of visitors each year who come to enjoy panoramic views of the city from its observation decks, dine at its restaurants, or simply admire its illuminated night-time spectacle.  

If you’re looking for a memorable spot to capture the essence of Paris, the Eiffel Tower is the quintessential choice.
